name: Youjo Ranbu 2
source:
Your mother, on her last breath, reveals the secret of your identity. After that, you, the hero of the story, travels around the world as a mercenary to find more about where you came from, and as you perform more tasks you find out more about yourself.

[From [url=http://densetsu.com/display.php?id=18&style=alphabetical]Anime Densetsu[/url]]
translation:
母亲临终前揭示了主人公身世的秘密。此后，你作为故事主人公，以佣兵身份周游世界，寻找自己的来历；随着完成越来越多的任务，你也将逐渐了解真正的自己。

[摘自[url=http://densetsu.com/display.php?id=18&style=alphabetical]Anime Densetsu[/url]]
